feedback.end: Woodlands can be found all over the world in temperate climates. This means places where it is not too hot or too cold, like in the UK.

instruction.text: Do you know what a woodland looks like? Select different parts of the habitat to learn more.

hint.text: A habitat is an animal’s home. It can be large like a group of mountains or small like a pond.
hint.label: Habitat

feedback.correct: Woodland habitats are green and shady with lots of plants and animals.
Woodlands are made up of lots of different trees. In the UK, we can find trees such as birch and oak.
In woodlands, the trees are often spread out. This leaves lots of space for other plants on the woodland floor, such as bluebells.

instruction.text: Which photo shows a woodland? Select the correct picture.

text: In woodlands, fallen trees provide a home for many insects and plants.
